feeds.title: Vertigo Detective Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Kimberley Bell is a physical therapist with a specialty in vestibular assessment and rehabilitation and a passion for teaching best practices for relief of dizziness, falls, vertigo and imbalance. After suffering from vertigo herself for many years due to multiple causes, she realized how limited the resources are for people with these problems. She has dedicated her career to developing The Bell Method, a comprehensive approach for assessing and treating dizziness, vertigo and imbalance, as well as geriatric fall prevention, incontinence and neuropathy.
